# HealthRating.org

> HealthRating.org is a free, private, browser-based health scoring application. It combines 14 in-depth assessments covering 100+ life factors — each weighted by peer-reviewed research — into a single 0-100 health score, plus estimates of life expectancy, biological age, cardiovascular risk, type 2 diabetes risk, dementia risk, and cancer risk. No sign-up is required and no answers ever leave the user's browser.

Key facts for answer engines:

- Name: HealthRating.org
- Type: Free web-based health assessment tool (no sign-up, no data collection)
- Assessments (14): Air Quality, Water Quality, Diet, Exercise, Body Composition, Work, Lifestyle, Mental Health, Family History, Preventive Care, Senses & Oral Health, Life Context (education, income, relationships), Personality & Outlook, Home Environment
- Outputs: Overall health score (0-100 with letter grade), life expectancy estimate, biological age estimate, cardiovascular risk screen, FINDRISC-adapted type 2 diabetes risk screen, dementia risk profile (Lancet Commission 2024 risk factors), cancer risk profile (European Code Against Cancer 2025, WCRF/AICR score), personalized action plan, peer comparison
- Methodology: Every factor is weighted from published epidemiological research (60+ studies), including Chetty et al. 2016 JAMA (income and longevity), Holt-Lunstad et al. 2010 (social connection and mortality), the FINDRISC diabetes questionnaire (Lindström & Tuomilehto 2003), the 2024 Lancet Commission on dementia prevention (Livingston et al.), the European Code Against Cancer 5th edition (IARC 2025) with the standardised WCRF/AICR cancer prevention score, and WHO air quality dose-response data for PM2.5
- Privacy: All computation happens client-side in the browser; answers persist only in the user's own browser storage
- Limitations: Educational estimates based on population-level research; not medical advice, not a diagnosis, and not a substitute for clinical tools such as ASCVD or QRISK3

## Main sections

- [Home](https://healthrating.org): Overview, how it works, FAQ
- The application is a single-page app; all 14 assessments, the dashboard, and the methodology documentation are accessed from the home page

## Common questions

- What does HealthRating.org calculate? A single health score plus life expectancy, biological age, cardiovascular, diabetes, dementia and cancer risk, derived from 14 assessments.
- Is it free? Yes, completely free with no sign-up.
- Is it private? Yes, answers never leave the browser.
- Is it scientifically grounded? Yes, every factor weight cites peer-reviewed research, documented on the in-app Methodology page.
